title: implement-frontend-feature input
description: Input contract for the implement-frontend-feature Generate stage. Validated by the workflow engine before invocation. Frontend banking-grade: a11y_requirements and pii_field_classification are required, not optional.

design_document.description: Approved design from an earlier design-frontend-feature stage. Markdown string OR structured object. Must declare L1 intent, L2 component tree + state ownership + rendering model, L3 a11y contract + error/loading/empty states + token-storage strategy, L4 file sketch.

target_feature_path.description: Existing path under src/ or app/. May include Next.js dynamic segment brackets (e.g., app/loan/application/[id]).

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4. Same key with same other inputs MUST produce same output bytes.

a11y_requirements.description: Blocking. No override below AA. Banking-grade regulatory requirement.

pii_field_classification.description: Per-field PII treatment rule. Empty array only if the feature renders zero PII.

field.description: Field name as it appears in the API contract.

treatment.description: mask = partial display (e.g., last 4 of account); redact = blackbox until reveal action; audit-on-view = emit pii.viewed event on display; none = field is not PII.

convention_overrides.description: Repo-specific overrides discovered by an upstream stage that should take precedence over greenfield defaults.

bundle_budget_kb.description: Per-feature bundle budget. Generate computes bundle_impact_estimate_kb; over-budget triggers uncertainty_flag of kind bundle_overrun.

test_coverage_target.description: Per-file coverage target. Below target signals loop_back.
